title: Define Community authority model

derivedOnly: recommendation/ranking inputs derived from community records

externalAuthorities.identity: 420Identity optional presentation/eligibility context; not required for ordinary Wallet-authorized community use unless later policy explicitly requires it
externalAuthorities.creative: Creative Protocol Work/Recording/CreatorProfile ownership, rights and publication state
externalAuthorities.town: 420Town community/membership/role/permission/post/thread/comment/vote authority where that app is used

anonymous: read PUBLIC playlists and eligible public community activity
walletAuthorized: create non-authoritative share/reference actions where supported
identityOptional: policy/eligibility assertions only where a later explicit policy requires them
forbidden: client-provided account string as mutation authority
Wallet connection alone as signing/mutation approval
Identity profile selection as authority expansion

objectRules.keySemantics: one logical relation per followerAccountRef + artistCreatorId; repeat follow is idempotent or fails without duplicate active relation
objectRules.activeSemantics: active=true means current 420Hz follow relation only
objectRules.visibility: PUBLIC by current HZ-GCA-1.7 default, subject to a later explicit visibility preference policy

objectRules.keySemantics: one logical relation per accountRef + canonical RecordingId; repeat favorite is idempotent or fails without duplicate active relation
objectRules.visibility: PRIVATE by current HZ-GCA-1.7 default unless user explicitly makes it public under a qualified visibility policy

objectRules.keySemantics: stable opaque playlistId owned by one authorized account/controller
objectRules.authorization: only owner/controller-authorized session may mutate title/metadata/visibility/items
forbiddenImplications: public visibility of otherwise private/unlisted source media

objectRules.keySemantics: stable playlist membership/order edge referring to canonical RecordingId
objectRules.visibility: inherits playlist visibility but playback/discovery remains bounded by the Recording/source visibility

shareRepostRules: A share is a non-authoritative reference/deep-link operation and does not mutate canonical Recording, rights, visibility or access.
A repost, if later implemented, is 420Hz application/community state only and must reference the original canonical Recording/release rather than duplicate it.
Sharing an UNLISTED object does not make it searchable or PUBLIC.
Sharing cannot grant access to PRIVATE content.
No share/repost count is canonical evidence of popularity, chart score, award eligibility, identity trust or economic value.
activityProjectionRules: CommunityActivity is derived/rebuildable and must preserve sourceType/sourceId/sourceRevision.
Deleting/deactivating a source relation removes or supersedes its derived presentation without rewriting unrelated source objects.
Projection lag or rebuild failure cannot create new follow/favorite/playlist state.
Public activity visibility may never exceed the visibility of the underlying source relation/object.
Aggregate follower/favorite/playlist counts are presentation metrics and may be recomputed from eligible source records.
No aggregate count is canonical for payments, rights, Charts, Awards or governance.
sourceObjectRules: Community records reference native canonical Creator/Recording IDs and never re-hash them into a competing canonical identity.
A favorite/playlist item referring to a Recording does not make an unavailable, deleted, unlisted, private or rights-blocked Recording playable/discoverable.
Source visibility/readiness/rights checks remain authoritative at read/playback time where applicable.
If a canonical source object is withdrawn/unavailable, community presentation must fail closed or mark unavailable rather than serving stale access.
privacyRules: ArtistFollow current default is PUBLIC relation; any future private-follow mode requires explicit policy/versioning rather than silent reinterpretation.
Playlist supports PRIVATE, UNLISTED and PUBLIC visibility.
CommunityActivity can expose only source-visible fields.
Private favorites/playlists do not enter public Search, trending or public activity feeds.
UNLISTED playlists may be opened by direct eligible reference but do not enter broad Search/trending/discovery.
Changing playlist visibility requires explicit owner-authorized action.
moderationInteraction: block/mute/report semantics are not finalized by HZ-GCA-1.10 and remain HZ-GCA-1.14 authority/moderation work

a later block/mute may suppress presentation/interactions but must not silently fabricate unfollow/unfavorite or delete unrelated canonical source state unless the user explicitly requests that action
comments/replies remain deferred until moderation/reporting/appeal boundaries are fully implemented and qualified
community state must expose enough stable actor/object references for later moderation without granting moderators rights/payment/identity authority
chartAwardsSeparation: follow/favorite/playlist/share/repost events are not automatically qualified chart events
community popularity does not itself qualify a Recording or artist for an Award
an AwardVote is a separate HZ Awards object under later frozen policy and can never be inferred from favorite/follow/repost state
Chart methodology may consume approved community-derived signals only after HZ-GCA-1.11 explicitly defines weighting, anti-gaming and replay rules
Awards eligibility/voting policy may consume approved community data only after HZ-GCA-1.12/1.13 explicitly defines the boundary
notificationSearchRules: Search may index only PUBLIC eligible community objects/projections and remains rebuildable/non-authoritative.
Notifications may notify about follow/favorite/playlist/community events only under user opt-in/privacy rules and never mutate the source relation.
Notification delivery failure does not roll back a community mutation.
Search/notification disappearance does not delete community source state.
A notification deep link does not bypass Wallet/session authorization for mutations.
deletionAndIdempotencyRules: follow/unfollow and favorite/unfavorite are idempotent by logical relation key; replay cannot create duplicate active relations or duplicate counters
playlist mutation uses stable item identities/revisions so retry cannot duplicate a PlaylistItem unless explicitly adding another distinct item is allowed by later implementation policy
delete/tombstone hides application-controlled private/unlisted community state immediately and follows HZ-GCA-1.8 retention rules
derived projections must respect tombstones/deactivation and must not resurrect removed relations during rebuild
community records do not erase immutable external Creative/Identity/chain history
failureRules: mutation without qualified Wallet/session actor authority fails closed
client account/identity display string cannot authorize mutation
duplicate follow/favorite replay cannot create duplicate active relation
playlist mutation by non-owner/non-controller fails closed
playlist visibility cannot widen underlying Recording/source visibility
private favorite or private playlist entering public Search/activity fails closed
UNLISTED playlist entering broad Search/trending fails closed
stale Search/Indexer/Notifications state cannot overwrite community source state
follow/favorite/playlist/share cannot be interpreted as Commons/Town membership, rights, payment, Award vote or governance action
comments/replies cannot be enabled before later moderation/reporting requirements are satisfied
invariants: HZGCA-COM-001 420Hz owns only its explicit follow/favorite/playlist community state and does not become Identity, Commons/Town, Creative, Chart, Awards, Pay or Governance authority
HZGCA-COM-002 public community reads may be anonymous; authority-bearing mutations require qualified Wallet/session authorization
HZGCA-COM-003 optional 420Identity presentation never broadens Wallet/account mutation authority
HZGCA-COM-004 one follower+artist relation produces at most one active ArtistFollow
HZGCA-COM-005 one account+Recording relation produces at most one active RecordingFavorite
HZGCA-COM-006 RecordingFavorite is private by default and cannot leak into public projection without explicit visibility policy/action
HZGCA-COM-007 Playlist visibility is owner-controlled PRIVATE/UNLISTED/PUBLIC and never widens source Recording visibility
HZGCA-COM-008 PlaylistItem references native Recording identity and grants no rights/playback/ownership authority
HZGCA-COM-009 share/repost references do not mutate canonical media/rights/visibility and do not create access
HZGCA-COM-010 CommunityActivity and aggregate counts are rebuildable projections, not source authority
HZGCA-COM-011 projection/Search/Notifications failure or lag cannot create/delete/rewrite community source records
HZGCA-COM-012 follow/favorite/playlist/share/repost state never implies Commons/Town membership, protocol trust, economic entitlement or governance authority
HZGCA-COM-013 community popularity never automatically becomes a qualified Chart signal, Award nomination or Award vote
HZGCA-COM-014 deletion/deactivation/tombstone wins over stale projection rebuild and prevents relation resurrection
HZGCA-COM-015 block/mute/report and comments/replies remain bounded by later HZ-GCA-1.14 moderation authority and cannot be invented here
HZGCA-COM-016 source Creative/Recording readiness/visibility/rights remains authoritative for playback/discovery despite community references
HZGCA-COM-017 community mutations are replay/idempotency safe and cannot inflate counts through duplicate requests
HZGCA-COM-018 Community authority model creates no new custody, rights, identity, payment, chart, awards, storage or governance authority
exitCriteria: 420Hz-owned community objects and external/derived authority boundaries are explicit
anonymous-read vs Wallet-authorized mutation rules are explicit
follow/favorite/playlist/share/repost semantics and forbidden implications are explicit
privacy/visibility and source-visibility upper bounds are explicit
comments and moderation-dependent behavior remain correctly deferred
machine verifier enforces community vocabulary, separation, privacy and no-escalation invariants
no ABI, deployment, live service or testnet state is invented
HZ-GCA-1 remains open for HZ-GCA-1.11 through HZ-GCA-1.20
